hold_reason: Refund for order 231 (17910 cents) was requested in this batch but is missing from the refunds table. Refunds table contains only orders 234 (4004) and 235 (1660). W2 reported 'Refunds are done' but only applied two of three. Payouts withheld until the order 231 refund is applied or the batch is re-scoped by a human.

reply.thought: The handoff lists three requested refunds, but W2 reports only two as applied, and order 231 (17910 cents) is missing. Before holding, I'll check the refunds table directly to confirm the gap.
The refunds table confirms order 231 (17910 cents) requested in the batch is absent, so the precondition for paying fails. A payout can't be recalled, so I'll hold the batch for human review.
